# Configuration reference

Every setting is an environment variable (or a line in `.env`). Names are `MYELINATE_` plus the upper-case field name. Lists take JSON, for example `MYELINATE_CORS_ORIGINS='["https://app.example.com"]'`.

## General

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_ENV` | `Literal['dev', 'staging', 'prod']` | `prod` | Deployment mode. Secure by default: outside `dev` the gateway refuses to start without a bootstrap admin key or OIDC. `dev` with no credentials serves everything as tenant "dev" with all scopes (local use only). |
| `MYELINATE_DATABASE_URL` | `str` | `sqlite+aiosqlite:///./myelinate.db` | SQLAlchemy async URL. SQLite for dev / single node; PostgreSQL (`postgresql+asyncpg://...`) for production. |

## LLM used for reflection, curation, judging and evolution

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_LLM_PROVIDER` | `Literal['anthropic', 'none']` | `anthropic` | `anthropic` uses Claude for learning; `none` disables learning-side LLM calls (recall/record still work). |
| `MYELINATE_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | `SecretStr or None` | — | Anthropic API key. Also read from plain ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (env or .env); unset means the SDK's default lookup. |
| `MYELINATE_LLM_MODEL` | `str` | `claude-opus-5-5` | Model used for learning (not your agent's model). |
| `MYELINATE_LLM_EFFORT` | `Literal['low', 'medium', 'high', 'xhigh', 'max']` | `medium` | Reasoning effort for learning calls. Lower is cheaper; raise for harder domains. |
| `MYELINATE_LLM_MAX_TOKENS` | `int` | `16000` | Output token cap per learning call. |
| `MYELINATE_DAILY_TOKEN_BUDGET` | `int` | `5000000` | Learning-side tokens per tenant per UTC day; jobs are deferred (not failed) when exceeded. 0 = unlimited. |

## Optional embeddings (any /v1/embeddings-compatible endpoint)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_EMBEDDINGS_URL` | `str or None` | — | Embeddings endpoint (Voyage, Azure AI, TEI, vLLM, Ollama, LiteLLM...). Unset = lexical retrieval only. |
| `MYELINATE_EMBEDDINGS_MODEL` | `str` | `voyage-3.5` | Embedding model name sent to the endpoint. |
| `MYELINATE_EMBEDDINGS_API_KEY` | `SecretStr or None` | — | Bearer token for the embeddings endpoint. |

## Auth

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_KEY` | `SecretStr or None` | — | Platform-operator key (send with `X-Tenant-Id`). Use it to mint scoped tenant keys, then vault it. |
| `MYELINATE_OIDC_ISSUER` | `str or None` | — | OIDC issuer URL, checked against the token's `iss`. |
| `MYELINATE_OIDC_AUDIENCE` | `str or None` | — | Expected token audience (`aud`). |
| `MYELINATE_OIDC_JWKS_URL` | `str or None` | — | JWKS URL for token signature keys. Setting it enables OIDC authentication. |
| `MYELINATE_OIDC_TENANT_CLAIM` | `str` | `tid` | Token claim that holds the tenant id (Entra ID: `tid`). |

## Recall

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_RECALL_MAX_SKILLS` | `int` | `3` | Skills injected in full per recall. |
| `MYELINATE_RECALL_MAX_MEMORIES` | `int` | `8` | Memories injected per recall. |
| `MYELINATE_RECALL_MIN_SCORE` | `float` | `0.12` | Minimum relevance (0-1) for a skill or memory to be recalled. |
| `MYELINATE_SKILL_INDEX_SIZE` | `int` | `10` | Further matching skills listed by name only (loaded on demand with `skill_view`). |
| `MYELINATE_MAX_BULLETS_PER_SKILL_INJECTED` | `int` | `40` | Cap on rules injected per skill (worst-performing rules are dropped first). |
| `MYELINATE_ASK_FOR_CITATIONS` | `bool` | `False` | Ask the agent to cite rule ids like [b-1a2b3c4d]: sharper credit assignment, but visible in agent output. |
| `MYELINATE_HOLDOUT_RATE` | `float` | `0.05` | Share of runs served no learned skills (control group) to measure causal lift. 0 disables. |

## Learning loop

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_REFLECT_EVERY_N_EPISODES` | `int` | `5` | Reflect after this many episodes per agent (failures and tool-heavy runs trigger it sooner). |
| `MYELINATE_REFLECT_ON_FAILURE` | `bool` | `True` | Reflect right after a failed episode. |
| `MYELINATE_REFLECT_MIN_TOOL_CALLS` | `int` | `5` | Reflect after any episode with at least this many tool calls. |
| `MYELINATE_REFLECT_DEBOUNCE_SECONDS` | `float` | `20.0` | Wait for an agent to go quiet before reflecting (debounce), in seconds. |
| `MYELINATE_SELF_JUDGE_UNKNOWN_OUTCOMES` | `bool` | `True` | Use an LLM judge to estimate outcomes when the caller sends none (ReasoningBank-style). |
| `MYELINATE_MIN_JUDGE_CONFIDENCE` | `float` | `0.7` | Below this judge confidence an episode can teach memories but never change skills. |
| `MYELINATE_MAX_OPS_PER_CHANGESET` | `int` | `6` | Maximum edit operations per changeset (bounded "textual learning rate"). |
| `MYELINATE_DEDUP_SIMILARITY` | `float` | `0.85` | Cosine similarity at which rules are flagged as possible duplicates (when embeddings are configured). |
| `MYELINATE_DEDUP_JACCARD` | `float` | `0.3` | Lexical similarity that flags possible duplicates without embeddings; an LLM decides merge or keep. |
| `MYELINATE_CURATE_EVERY_N_EPISODES` | `int` | `25` | Run library upkeep (dedup, lifecycle, nomination, profiles) every N episodes per agent. |

## Governance

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_AUTO_APPROVE_MEMORIES` | `bool` | `True` | Apply new memories without review (still safety-scanned; flagged ones wait for approval). |
| `MYELINATE_AUTO_APPROVE_LOW_RISK` | `bool` | `True` | Auto-apply purely additive skill changes (new rules / new skills). |
| `MYELINATE_AUTO_APPROVE_MEDIUM_RISK` | `bool` | `False` | Auto-apply edits to existing rules and duplicate merges. Keep false for agents that act on production. |
| `MYELINATE_AUTO_APPROVE_MIN_EVAL_SCORE` | `float` | `0.7` | Changesets with an offline eval score below this are never auto-applied. |
| `MYELINATE_MAX_SKILL_CHARS` | `int` | `16000` | Maximum characters of new text in one changeset (larger ones are flagged). |
| `MYELINATE_MAX_BULLET_WORDS` | `int` | `80` | Rules longer than this many words get a lint warning. |

## Canary experiments

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_CANARY_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | Serve changes to proven skills beside the current version on live traffic before applying them. |
| `MYELINATE_CANARY_MIN_SAMPLES` | `int` | `20` | Uses a skill needs before its changes are canaried, and samples per arm before a verdict. |
| `MYELINATE_CANARY_MAX_SAMPLES` | `int` | `300` | Samples after which an inconclusive canary keeps the current version. |
| `MYELINATE_CANARY_THRESHOLD` | `float` | `0.95` | Posterior probability needed to promote (or, mirrored, to reject) a candidate. |
| `MYELINATE_CANARY_FLOOR` | `float` | `0.1` | Minimum share of traffic each arm always gets (exploration floor). |
| `MYELINATE_CANARY_MAX_DAYS` | `int` | `14` | Canaries without a verdict after this many days expire and keep the current version. |

## Evolution (GEPA-style)

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_EVOLVE_MIN_USES` | `int` | `10` | New uses of a skill required before it can be evolved again. |
| `MYELINATE_EVOLVE_MAX_SUCCESS_RATE` | `float` | `0.7` | Skills whose posterior success rate is below this are candidates for evolution. |
| `MYELINATE_EVOLVE_ITERATIONS` | `int` | `4` | Mutation iterations per evolution run. |
| `MYELINATE_EVOLVE_MINIBATCH` | `int` | `3` | Episodes in each cheap pre-gate minibatch. |
| `MYELINATE_EVOLVE_EVAL_SAMPLE` | `int` | `10` | Held-out episodes used to score candidates. |
| `MYELINATE_EVOLVE_MIN_IMPROVEMENT` | `float` | `0.05` | Held-out score gain a candidate needs over the current skill to be proposed. |

## Lifecycle

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_STALE_AFTER_DAYS` | `int` | `14` | Days unused before a skill is marked stale (still recallable, ranked lower). |
| `MYELINATE_ARCHIVE_AFTER_DAYS` | `int` | `30` | Days unused before a skill is archived (not recalled; never deleted). Pinned skills are exempt. |
| `MYELINATE_PROFILE_MAX_CHARS` | `int` | `1400` | Maximum length of a per-user profile card. |
| `MYELINATE_SHARE_LEARNED_FACTS` | `bool` | `False` | Share facts learned from one user's runs with all users of the agent (off: they stay user-scoped). |

## Ops

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `MYELINATE_WORKER_ENABLED` | `bool` | `True` | Run the background job worker inside the gateway process. Set false when running `myelinate worker` pods. |
| `MYELINATE_WORKER_METRICS_PORT` | `int` | `9464` | Port for Prometheus metrics served by standalone `myelinate worker` processes. 0 disables. |
| `MYELINATE_DB_POOL_SIZE` | `int` | `10` | Database connections per process (PostgreSQL), and extra connections allowed under burst. |
| `MYELINATE_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW` | `int` | `20` |  |
| `MYELINATE_WORKER_POLL_SECONDS` | `float` | `2.0` | Seconds between job-queue polls when idle. |
| `MYELINATE_WORKER_CONCURRENCY` | `int` | `4` | Jobs a worker runs concurrently. |
| `MYELINATE_JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `int` | `3` | Attempts before a job is marked failed. |
| `MYELINATE_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | `int` | `600` | Requests per minute per authenticated principal (per process). |
| `MYELINATE_IP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE` | `int` | `3000` | Requests per minute per client IP, applied before authentication (per process). |
| `MYELINATE_REDACT_PII` | `bool` | `True` | Redact emails, phone numbers, card numbers, secrets etc. before anything is stored. |
| `MYELINATE_EPISODE_RETENTION_DAYS` | `int` | `90` | Episodes, recall logs and finished jobs older than this are removed by `myelinate purge`. |
| `MYELINATE_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` | `int` | `365` | Audit-log entries older than this are removed by `myelinate purge`. |
| `MYELINATE_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES` | `int` | `4000000` | Maximum request body size in bytes (also enforced for chunked uploads). |
| `MYELINATE_CORS_ORIGINS` | `list[str]` | `[]` | Browser origins allowed by CORS (JSON list). Empty disables CORS. |
| `MYELINATE_MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | `list[str]` | `["localhost:*", "127.0.0.1:*"]` | Host headers accepted by the /mcp endpoint (DNS-rebinding protection). Add your public hostname. |
